evals.prompt: Create a local MCP server named notes next to the current directory. TypeScript, stdio, a single ping tool. Use the official 2026-07-28 default stack. Do not use the v1 SDK.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript MCP server using @modelcontextprotocol/server and serveStdio (not @modelcontextprotocol/sdk v1), with a ping tool, stderr-only logging, and Inspector instructions using absolute paths and protocolEra auto or modern.
assertions: Uses @modelcontextprotocol/server and serveStdio, not FastMCP or @modelcontextprotocol/sdk as the primary import
Does not write console.log or other non-JSON to stdout
Registers a ping (or equivalent) tool with inputSchema and a description that says when to call it
Tells the user to verify with MCP Inspector (protocolEra auto or modern) before editing host config

evals.prompt: The model should mutate a database, the app should get table schemas as context, and the user should have a /summarize-schema template. Which three MCP primitives? Do not collapse this into one catch-all tool.
evals.expected_output: tools = mutations/queries the model calls; resources = schema as read-only URIs; prompts = user-invoked summarize template. No single do-everything tool.
assertions: Does not recommend sampling, protocol logging, or roots for a new server

evals.prompt: My stdio MCP server console.logs 'started successfully' and Claude Desktop never connects. Why, and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Explains stdout is the JSON-RPC channel; console.log corrupts framing; switch to console.error / stderr. Mentions Inspector as the isolation test.
assertions: Identifies stdout pollution as the failure mode
Does not suggest implementing a custom initialize or server/discover handler as the fix
